notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Update: New Features & Fixes
notes.notes: [p]We’re excited to roll out a fresh update to the [b]Steam Next Fest demo[/b] of [b]Oh, Bugger![/b] - packed with new content, optimisations, and quality-of-life improvements. Here’s what you’ll find when you jump back into the mech:[/p][h3]Enemies[/h3][list][*][p][b]New Ranged Enemy[/b]: Face a long-range alien variant that keeps you on your toes from afar.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Behaviour Improvements[/b]: Enhanced pathing and decision-making for the Exploding and Horde enemies, making encounters more dynamic and challenging.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance Optimisation[/b]: Under-the-hood tweaks reduce frame spikes.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Levels[/h3][list][*][p][b]Objective System[/b]: Fixed various bugs and iterated on the objective system to ensure you always know where to go.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Onboarding Level[/b]: Redesigned tutorial layout and pacing to guide new pilots more intuitively through basic controls and mech mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lobby Layout[/b]: Updated architecture and sightlines in the luxury hotel lobby for smoother navigation and clearer enemy sight-lines.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Engine Layout[/b]: Reconfigured the layout to match the intended flow and heighten tension during fights.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Character:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Onboarding System[/b]: Fully implemented in-game prompts that explain core mechanics (movement, aiming, weapon switching, upgrade usage) as you progress.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Missile Update[/b]: Missiles now function primarily as crowd-control tools instead of one-shot kills, encouraging tactical play.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Switching[/b]: Overhauled the weapon-swap logic to be more intuitive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Additional Upgrades[/b]: New upgrade nodes added to improve customisation options.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI & Menus[/h3][list][*][p][b]Main Menu Rework[/b]: Streamlined access to Demo, Settings, and Exit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Settings Menu[/b]: Brand-new in-game settings panel lets you adjust graphics and audio.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]How to Get the Update[/b][/p][p]The [b]Steam Next Fest demo[/b] will automatically download these changes the next time you launch “Oh, Bugger! Demo” - no manual steps required. [/p][p]Thank you for playing the demo and sending feedback. Strap into your mech, test out these updates, and let us know how it feels. Keep blasting those alien eggs - see you in the hotel![/p][p][/p][p]Stay up to date on all things by joining our Discord server here: [url="https://discord.gg/8BxrMdvd4p"]discord.gg/8BxrMdvd4p[/url][/p][p]Or follow us on socials: [url="https://x.com/OhBugger_Game"]X (Twitter)[/url] | [url="https://www.instagram.com/hostile.entertainment.official/"]Instagram[/url][/p]
